steps.message: Use the browser tools to open https://example.com, then call the screenshot tool with no filename so the image comes back to you, and reply with the main heading you see in it.
I’ll use the browser toolchain for this, then inspect the screenshot directly so I’m answering from what’s rendered rather than guessing.
